summary.text: Stephen Villee, a Libertarian software developer from Hampton, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of New Hampshire to Kelly Ayotte.
He was also the party's nominee in 2024, and his campaign called for approval voting, legal adult cannabis, "Defend the Guard" legislation and medical use of psilocybin.

paragraphs.text: Villee works as a software developer and has a bachelor's degree in mathematics from Harvard University.
He lives in Hampton, New Hampshire, and is not currently serving in a New Hampshire office.

Villee's campaign website said he probably would not win as a third-party candidate and proposed that libertarians from around the country move to New Hampshire until they make up enough of the electorate to win a plurality.

His stated legislative priorities were adopting approval voting, fully legalizing cannabis for adults, passing legislation that would require a congressional declaration of war before the New Hampshire National Guard could be activated, and legalizing medical psilocybin for post-traumatic stress disorder, substance use disorder and treatment-resistant depression.
He received 1.5% of the vote to Kelly Ayotte's 51.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
